title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10888)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10888) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10888). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 5904 - 1981 'Gymnastic equipment — Landing mats and surfaces for floor exercises — Determination of resistance to sliping' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Sports Goods Sectional Committee and approved by the Consumer Products and Medical Instruments Division Council. Coma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker, while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. Wherever the words read as 'Indian Standard'. 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be In this Indian Standard the following International Standards are referred to. Read in their respective places the corresponding Indian Standards also given below: International Standard ISO 5905- 1980 Gymnastic equipment — Landing mats ( 2 000 mm x 1 250 mm 60 mm) ISO 5906-1980 Gymnastic equipmentSurfaces

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
